title: DDNS management
recordNameHelp: Enter @, *, a single relative label, or a fully qualified name within this zone.
editBindingHelp: Renaming this A or AAAA record replaces it at the DNS provider and removes its old name. Other records are preserved.
renameReviewHelp: Confirm the rename against the DNS provider. You can cancel it if the original record is intact and the target name has no record of this type.
renamePrepareHelp: Continue this rename or cancel it to keep the original binding.
renameInterfaceUnavailable: The requested network interface must report before the rename can continue.
confirmUnbind: Stop DDNS updates for this record?
confirmRotate: Replace the node token? The current token will stop working immediately.
confirmDelete: Delete this node and all its DNS bindings?
tokenHelp: Save this token in the DDNS agent configuration. It is shown only once.
copyFailed: Clipboard access failed. Reveal the token to copy it manually.
